access: A Databricks workspace with a development target where the agent may deploy and run the job

presentation.name: Design Databricks jobs that retry and repair without duplicating data
presentation.summary: Designs Lakeflow Jobs so that retries, repairs, queued runs and triggers never write the same data twice, with the right compute for each task.
benefits: Makes every task safe to re-run, with an explicit window per run instead of one computed from the clock
Explains what a repair re-runs and why it uses the job's current settings, not the original run's
Sets run-if conditions, retries, timeouts, concurrency and queueing so runs are neither skipped nor overlapping
Chooses schedule, file-arrival, table-update or continuous triggers, and serverless, job or SQL warehouse compute per task
Configures the dbt task for dbt Core with pinned adapter, commands and Git source
